name: harsi-trading
description: HARSI AI trading terminal — session algorithms, paper trading, and broker adapters.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @harsi/api" "npm run dev -w @harsi/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @harsi/web && npm run build -w @harsi/api
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @harsi/api" "npm run start -w @harsi/web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @harsi/web --if-present && npm run lint -w @harsi/api --if-present
